title: Integration with Azure Static Web Apps from Business Central
summary: This post explains how to integrate an Azure Static Web App with Business Central by using the WebPageViewer control add-in and the window.postMessage API to enable bidirectional communication between AL code and a hosted web application.
key_points: WebPageViewer control add-in loads web content in an iframe within a Business Central page
Use window.postMessage API for two-way communication between AL code and the web app
AL code subscribes to message events and posts messages using SubscribeToEvent and PostMessage methods
Web app listens for messages with addEventListener and responds using window.parent.postMessage
Azure Static Web App must be served over proper SSL certificate for WebPageViewer to load it

quotes.text: This is the scenario that we have on the BC web client page. The WebPageViewer control add in loads its content inside an iframe.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core architecture where the web app runs in an iframe context, enabling message-based communication with AL code
